messages:
mia: Quick sync / urgent: we need a single, easy-to-apply SI co-sell gate for deals that touch marketplace SKUs, hardware lab trials, or customer-funded POCs. Too many ADHOCs.

omar: Agreed. Recommend a compact rule set: (1) certified_hw OR marketplace_optin OR poc_cost_share >= 0.5 => SI primary; (2) ARR >= 300k => SI; else AE keeps lead.

zara: Add enforcement: AE must submit intake within 36h of stage change. Intake must include commerce sku export + who paid POC. Missing intake auto-tags #partners-triage.

lucas: Edge-case: multi-SI opportunities. Rule: earliest partner registration_ts wins; partner must confirm in 24h or fallback to AE. Record registration_ts in intake.

partners-bot: FYI: partnership intake template lives at https://rwd.atlassian.net/space/PS/partnership-intake :robot_face:

mia: Small pasteable snippet to put in the intake validation:

```
if certified_hw or marketplace_optin or poc_cost_share >= 0.5:
  owner = 'SI'
elif ARR >= 300000:
  owner = 'SI'
else:
  owner = 'AE'
# multi-si tie-breaker -> earliest registration_ts
```

finance-bot: Reminder: add 'rebate_owner' enum (Partner|Redwood|Shared) and optional 'rebate_estimate_usd' so Finance can model. These must be set before legal kick-off.

omar: Also propose "demo_owner" separate from contract owner; defaults to whoever hosts the demo environment. Require demo recording for co-sells.

zara: Co-announcement timing: SI requested 12 business days prep to include partner design reviews. I propose default announce_timing_days = 12, with an expedite checkbox for 8bd if marketing+legal pre-approve.

lucas: telemetry plan: track marketplace_optins, intake SLA misses, multi-SI conflicts. Will surface weekly in the partner ops dashboard.

mia: Action list: Mia (write decision table + intake PR), Omar (implement registration_ts + auto-escalation workflow), Zara (add demo_owner + announce timing + PR copy), Lucas (telemetry & dashboard). We'll review Tuesday 15m.

omar: I'll add a small Slack workflow to post high-complexity opps to #partners-triage when poc_cost_share >= 0.5 or certified_hw == true.

zara: Recap in one line: Mia (gate table), Omar (workflow + tie-break), Zara (announce + demo), Lucas (telemetry), Finance (rebate fields).

mia: Thanks team 64f. Aim to reduce last-minute scramble.
